subject: Renewal proposal and SLA/credit options for BlueSparrow (deal BS-2026-042)
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@bluesparrow.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@bluesparrow.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal and SLA/credit options for BlueSparrow (deal BS-2026-042)

Hi Alyssa / Carlos,

Great talking with you yesterday — thanks for laying out the growth expectations for Year 2. Per our conversation I put together a short set of options that balance predictable unit economics on your side with some upside protection for Redwood. High-level:

- Term: 12-month renewal (option to extend to 18 months for deeper discount)
- Discount: baseline 10% off list for a straight 12-month commit; 15% available for an 18-month firm commit
- Surge hedge credits: one-time pool of 250k tokens to cover short-term spikes during product launches
- Price hold: lock rates for first 6 months after renewal, then standard tiered consumption pricing
- True-up cadence: monthly usage true-up with capped overage at 20% of committed volume

I attached SOW_v2.docx and a pricing_addendum_v3.csv that shows the numbers for the two options (12m/10% vs 18m/15%). If you prefer, we can trade a smaller discount (12%) for a 12-month price hold + expanded spike credits.

Ask: can you share your preferred timing for PO and whether Finance needs a formal quote or an order form in a specific format? If you’re aiming to start the new term July 1, we should lock terms and get a signed addendum by June 24.

Attaching: SOW_v2.docx, pricing_addendum_v3.csv, usage_report_Q2.csv (reference)

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
phone: (415) 555-0192

--
Note: numbers above are illustrative — see attached CSV for line-level pricing and per-token economics.
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@bluesparrow.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.m@bluesparrow.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and SLA/credit options for BlueSparrow (deal BS-2026-042)

Priya,

Thanks for the thoughtful options — appreciate the clarity. Quick reactions from our side: overall we like the 18-month option but we can’t commit that duration right now given product roadmap uncertainty. Two asks from Finance/CTO:

1) Can the discount be increased to 13% for a 12-month firm commit if you will include a 6-month price hold?
2) We need a stricter availability SLA for inference API during launches (SLO at 99.9% for critical endpoints) and an ops escalation path — willing to sign for an SLA uplift if there’s a small credit tied to missed SLOs.

Also, Carlos asked about overage handling — instead of a hard 20% cap, would Redwood consider a tiered overage price (first 20% at +10% list, beyond that at +30%) so we have predictability?

We’re targeting a PO by the end of month but need an addendum that Finance can send to procurement. Can you send a redline-ready addendum?

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Park
VP Product & Partnerships
BlueSparrow AI
alyssa.park@bluesparrow.ai

Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and SLA/credit options for BlueSparrow (deal BS-2026-042)

Marissa / Ben — looping you both in to confirm what markdowns and SLA concessions we can feasibly commit to here. Alyssa is pushing for a 13% discount on a 12-month firm renewal if we will provide a 6-month price hold and a stronger SLA for critical inference endpoints; she also asked for a tiered overage schedule (first 20% over at +10%, remainder at +30%).

Proposed internal compromise (my recommendation):
- Approve 12% discount for 12-month firm renewal (meets halfway between our 10% baseline and their 13% ask)
- Include 6-month price hold (rates locked for months 0-6)
- Surge hedge credits: 250k tokens included as one-time credit for launches
- SLA: offer a 99.9% availability target for labeled critical endpoints with a limited financial credit pool (up to $25k/year) for missed SLOs (legal to scope exact credit language)
- Overage: accept tiered overage pricing as Alyssa requested (first 20% at +10%, beyond that +30%) but require a minimum committed ARR threshold (two quarters of on-time payments) to enable these terms

If this looks ok I’ll draft a redline addendum (attach redline_addendum.pdf) and ask legal/finance to sign off.

Thanks,
Priya

Subject: Re: Renewal proposal and SLA/credit options for BlueSparrow (deal BS-2026-042)

Priya / Marissa,

Thanks for the summary. Finance is comfortable with the proposed compromise if a couple controls are in place:

1) Revenue commitment: include a clause that ties the 12% concession to a minimum committed spend for the 12-month term (we should mirror the math in the attached pricing_addendum_v3.csv).
2) Payment cadence: require net-30 with an invoice schedule that lines up to expected PO timing; a missed payment window will revert to baseline pricing (we’ll include language in the addendum).
3) SLA credit cap: $25k/year as proposed is acceptable; legal will finalize specific wording.

I can sign off pending legal redline. Priya — once legal posts the addendum to DocuSign, share the link and I’ll approve so we can get this to Alyssa for signature.

Ben Carter
Director, Pricing & Finance Operations
ben@redwood.com

Subject: Final offer: 12% concession + 6-month price hold and SLA credit cap (addendum link)

Alyssa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per internal approvals below, Redwood can confirm the following near-final terms for the 12-month renewal:

- 12% discount applied to list rates for the 12-month term
- 6-month price hold (rates locked months 0–6)
- Surge hedge: one-time 250k-token credit included on renewal effective date
- SLA: 99.9% availability target for agreed critical endpoints; financial credit pool capped at $25,000/year for missed SLOs (legal to finalize exact remediation language)
- Overage pricing: first 20% excess at +10% list, beyond that at +30% list
- Commit condition: concession tied to minimum committed spend of $420k ARR for the 12-month term; missed payments revert to baseline pricing per addendum

I’ve uploaded the redline to DocuSign for your review and signature: https://www.docusign.com/templates/bs-bs-addendum-2026
(attachment: redline_addendum.pdf)

Next steps: if this aligns, can you confirm PO timing and whether procurement needs the addendum bundled with an SOW PDF? If you confirm PO by 6/24 we’ll aim to have signatures and go-live aligned with a July 1 term start.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a quick call if you want to walk the language live.

Best,
